snippet.title: Swordcery - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817030/Swordcery/

Swordcery is a roguelite ARPG indie game where you can collect and wield an arsenal of spellbound blades! Here's the brand new trailer showing some of our wild blades!

Join our discord: https://discord.com/invite/YNMYDr7

#swordcery #roguelite #roguelike #indiegames
